name: Jiae Oh
tagline: I find problems before being asked, and carry them through to shipped, measured results.
intro: Product Designer working across fintech, enterprise data and B2B products. I design from evidence rather than opinion, and I build hands-on — currently designing and shipping a hospitality operations app end to end.

about.heading: About
body: I'm a product designer based in Manchester. My work spans fintech, enterprise data platforms and B2B operational software — the kind of products people use all day, under time pressure, to get real work done.

I design from evidence. I'm ADsP certified in data analytics, and I'd rather read the session data and talk to users on shift than argue from taste. At a crypto exchange I found that low signups were a trust problem, not a button problem, and the redesign that followed moved conversion from 4% to 25%.

I also build. I work hands-on with Claude Code, Cursor and Figma MCP, and I document design systems so developers can pick them up and run. Right now I'm designing and shipping a hospitality operations app end to end with a remote developer.
Before the UK, I studied Communication Design in Seoul and worked across enterprise dashboards, fintech and operational systems.

contact.cta: Open to Product Designer roles in the UK. The fastest way to reach me is email.

selectedWork.heading: Selected work
selectedWork.note: Shorter engagements, included for range rather than depth.

items.title: Marin Consulting — Paper to digital manufacturing records
items.body: Digitised a paper-based manufacturing records system as sole designer, researching through paper-form analysis and developer field reports under security-restricted site access. I mirrored the existing paper conventions in the UI, down to form colour coding, so engineers needed almost no retraining.

items.title: Kia Motors — New-car delivery onboarding
items.meta: UI / Motion Graphic Designer · Remote · Nov–Dec 2025
items.body: Designed screen-guided walkthroughs that new owners follow inside their vehicle at handover, plus a looping motion intro. Worked within Kia's design system and agency-led review cycles; shipped and in use.
